decided.singular: Daily maxima far above neighbouring days (114 on day 1, 117 on day 121, 114 on day 135, 86 on day 174, 85 on day 239, 62 on day 296, 89 on day 365) and multi-day runs of high means (days 40-44, 68-70, 78-84), plus the unusually low run of days 297-303 (means 5-10).
decided.highest: Q1 has the longest stretches of high daily means (40-65 in mid-February and March); no other quarter comes close.
decided.lowest: Q3 has long flat stretches with means around 10-14 (days 185-218, 243-266), but Q2 and Q4 are close, so this call is marginal.
decided.recurrence: Scanning the daily means, I found no regular 5-10 day rise and fall; the high periods come as irregular episodes.

answer.guess: Hourly particulate matter (PM10 or PM2.5, µg/m³) at a European station, with New Year fireworks peaks on days 1 and 365.
